title: I've added Shiny Sprites info my game :D
author: Warm-Comfort6536
selftext:
I've fully implemented Shiny Sprites, I've done this for sprites 1-5 and made shinies for all of their evolutions, and yes sprite 1-3 are the starters let me know what you think, I'd love to get some feedback on how they look, and yes they're AI generated :3   
  
(the 2nd evolution of the slime is going to be changed, the 4th evo of the slime hasn't been made yet)  
  
I've also made some changes to the battle screen and the consistency of the UI's artstyle, instead of going further 2D pixelated look with the battle screen background I went with a 3D background image that looks like the overworld environment, now I'm planning to set up something like weather in the background, or maybe clouds moving in front and behind those mountains back there :D

Game Link: [jaydenandressen.itch.io/pixelspritesuniverse](http://jaydenandressen.itch.io/pixelspritesuniverse)

comments.author: beneficialdiet18
comments.body: What did you use to generate them?

replies.author: Warm-Comfort6536
replies.body:
I used CivitAi website (I switched to ComfyUI for PC for the same results),  
  
Model used was Prefect Pony XL and the LORA used was sakuemonq Artist Style, then just followed up with photoshop and editing, sometimes putting them through ComfyUI a 2nd time for good measure :)

comments.author: theYAKUZI
comments.body: They look kinda good until u zoom in , besides that probably consider turning them into real pixel art

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: The Shiny Sprites add personality and replay value, and it’s great that you’ve already covered multiple evolutions and starters. The shift to a 3D-style battle background works well and helps unify the overworld and combat visually. Adding weather or moving elements sounds like a natural next step. You might consider posting this on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) to get deeper feedback and ideas.
